_comment: MCP server registry template. Copy to registry.json and fill in real values, OR bootstrap entirely from the WebUI (Global MCP editor). registry.json is gitignored (contains tokens). `${ENV_VAR}` placeholders are supported and expanded from .env / process environment at load time. Only no-auth stdio servers are shipped as examples; add auth-requiring servers (SSE/streamable_http with bearer tokens, or servers needing API keys) yourself via the WebUI.
